title: Service account
what: The account the service runs as, read from the passwd database and answered with whether a desktop password is kept, in src/account.rs.

title: Service command
what: The binary's words: serve, health, openapi, nouns, and node remote-desktop with --port and --default, which read and write the store, in src/main.rs and src/command.rs.

title: Health route
what: The health route answering whether the store is open and the service answers, and the command that asks another instance through the client, in src/health.rs.

title: HTTP plumbing
what: The router every route registers itself with, the bearer token check, the refusal shape, the route names the OpenAPI document lists and the 404 answer, in src/http.rs.

title: Service lifecycle
what: The one run of the service: it opens the store, reads the account, starts the desktop sidecar, binds the settings' address and answers until an interrupt or terminate, in src/lib.rs and deploy/bmo-remote.service.

title: OpenAPI document
what: The OpenAPI document generated from the wire types and the route list, printed by the openapi command and kept in docs/openapi.json, in src/openapi.rs and src/wire.rs.

title: Service settings
what: The layered settings read at start from the built-in defaults, settings.toml, settings.local.toml and BMO_REMOTE_ environment keys, with the server, desktop, sidecar, terminal and store tables, in src/settings.rs.

title: Service store
what: The SQLite store opened and migrated when the service starts, holding the port the desktop relay dials, in src/store.rs and migrations/.
